The October 26 maintainer request has therefore been answered; the old waiting-on-author artifact is stale.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that Win+Alt+Space works while PowerToys is running and that startup was disabled. That changes the earlier diagnosis. After enabling Run at startup, please restart once and tell us whether PowerToys is actually running and Win+Alt+Space works before opening any settings. If it does, does Alt+Space fail with that same running host?
